# Phase One — Limitless Continuation Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos is beyond page, route, shell, and screen; Awtsmoos.com may still reveal one digital garden where every chamber is simple at first touch and infinitely deep when opened.

## Unbounded possibilities

- Every route receives an explicit document identity and no route depends on anonymous global selectors.
- Shared components are rooted to dedicated component contracts, not generic classes that accidentally style unrelated pages.
- Every page begins with a calm primary task and moves advanced controls into native disclosure, sheets, drawers, inspectors, command palettes, or expandable cards.
- Mobile becomes the canonical layout. Desktop adds space, never hidden assumptions.
- Search, navigation, identity, status, primary action, and advanced context follow recognizable patterns while retaining route-specific personality.
- Every sticky or fixed object has an explicit semantic layer and corresponding content clearance.
- Intentional scroll regions own their overflow; the document itself remains horizontally stable at 320px.
- Complex editor/drive/admin pages gain narrow-screen modes where secondary panes collapse cleanly rather than shrinking into unusable slivers.
- Every interactable control gets hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, selected/open/busy, and error/success states where semantically meaningful.
- Pointer-only motion disappears on coarse pointers; reduced motion preserves all behavior without decorative movement.
- CSS animations use transform/opacity whenever possible and never exist merely to look futuristic.
- Shared design language comes from tokens and component contracts, not unscoped overrides.
- JavaScript boot modules become tiny assemblies. Views own DOM. Policies own validation/state. Gateways own transport/storage. Coordinators own lifecycle.
- Network operations expose cancellation, timeout, retry boundaries, stale-state handling, and explicit user feedback.
- API facades stay tiny while advanced domain modules remain composable underneath.
- Route documentation explains entrypoint, body/root selector contract, style graph, JS assembly, public API, tests, and extension seams.
- Every migrated route gains a machine-checkable isolation audit so later regressions become visible immediately.
- Archive/test/generated pages are classified rather than blindly migrated.
- The procedural-world family receives the same page-level rigor plus deeper geology, botany, ecology, tree, grass, texture, and creature systems.

## Five competing architectures

### A — One universal stylesheet
Rejected: fastest superficially, worst conflict risk.

### B — Every page completely independent
Rejected: maximal isolation but wasteful duplication and divergent interaction behavior.

### C — Route-local manifests plus opt-in component contracts
Preferred: each route owns its cascade while shared components require explicit roots.

### D — Shadow-DOM everything
Rejected for current codebase: invasive and mismatched to existing DOM/runtime contracts.

### E — Runtime-generated scoped CSS
Rejected as primary strategy: unnecessary complexity and harder debugging than static route roots.

## Chosen revelation

Use C: route-local manifests, explicit route/document roots, dedicated shared component roots, bounded semantic layers, and small JS architectural authorities.
